Subject: Atlas demo recording + slides — Q&A?

Hi Caroline,

Thanks again for your time today — really enjoyed the conversation and learning more about how Atlas AI routes inference across multiple cloud providers. As promised, attaching the demo recording and the slide deck for your team to review: both are linked below and attached for convenience.

Quick recap / next steps from our side:
- We showed a sample workload that reduced tail latency by ~30% using batching + prefix caching.
- Suggested next step: a short profiler run with a pilot dataset to validate latency and cost numbers (I included a simple checklist in slide 7).

Attachments / links:
- Atlas-demo-recording.mp4 (recording)
- Atlas-demo-slides.pdf (slides)
- Recording (streaming): https://redwood.app/recordings/atlas-20261215

If it helps, I can schedule a 15–20 minute Q&A to walk through any slide or specific integration questions — happy to do a short call with you and your infra/ML engineer. I’m available Thurs 12/17 10–11am PT or Mon 12/21 11am–2pm PT; if none of those work send a couple times that do.

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
